name: UT:Soul Of The Void {Reborn}
desc:
Welcome to Undertale:Soul Of The Void! (SOTV for short).
This challenge is designed to test your solo or teamwork - it is not meant to be beaten solo! Gather your friends.
Show your support! If you have fun, please Like the game! 👍

— Important Notice —

[This game is currently in development. Content is subject to change, and bugs may occur. We appreciate your patience!]
Heavily inspired by the best of the genre: "Undertale:Soul Ops", "Undertale Typical Ops II" and "Undertale Soulbound Devastation".

Undertale created by Toby Fox.

Shutdown = Update/Bug Fixes
Game version v1.03
